reason: The picture names fibroblast conditions as the route from unspecialized cells to connective-tissue cells, which may help make the supporting material.
expectation: A subset of the stem cells will develop toward fibroblasts.

alternatives.reason: That named route should prepare the other cell branch and also serves a goal.

effect: The fibroblast route produced cells with active collagen messages, while the original stem-cell population remains available for the muscle branch.
reaction: The unchanged DNA alongside active collagen genes makes the different-work idea clearer.
reason: The cells have collagen messages heading toward ribosomes, and amino acids are the building blocks for proteins.
expectation: The cells will use the amino acids to make collagen or its precursor.

alternatives.reason: I could start the separate muscle branch first.

effect: The fibroblasts have made collagen precursors and packed them into secretory vesicles, suggesting the next step is outside the cells.
reaction: The picture connects the collagen messages to protein production clearly.
reason: The goal asks for supporting material outside cells, and the extracellular fluid picture shows processing enzymes in that space.
expectation: The fibroblasts will release collagen precursors into the fluid to form supporting material.

alternatives.reason: I could begin the separate muscle branch instead.

effect: The fibroblasts released collagen, forming supporting material outside the cells and completing that goal.
reaction: It is helpful to see that tissue includes material around cells as well as the cells themselves.
reason: The picture names skeletal-muscle conditions as the route from unspecialized cells to muscle precursors, matching the remaining goal.
expectation: A separate subset of stem cells will develop into muscle precursors.

effect: The muscle conditions produced individual muscle-lineage cells with messages for muscle proteins, but not mature muscle fibres.
reaction: This parallels the fibroblast branch while showing different genes in use.
reason: As with the collagen messages, the muscle protein messages need amino acid building blocks.
expectation: The cells will use the amino acids to make muscle proteins and advance toward muscle-forming cells.

effect: The muscle-lineage cells used amino acids to make muscle proteins, becoming separate muscle precursors rather than mature fibres. Both goals are complete.
reaction: The comparison with collagen helped show how different messages can use the same building blocks.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making collagen-rich material outside the fibroblasts was most worthwhile because it showed that tissue includes supporting material around cells, not just cells themselves.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making muscle proteins felt a little repetitive after the similar collagen step, although the comparison had a purpose.

surprise.text: I was interested that cells with the same DNA could use different messages and make different proteins from the same amino-acid supply.

arbitrary.text: The named differentiation conditions made the pairings clear, but I did not understand exactly how the changing signals directed each cell type.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the separate muscle precursors develop into muscle fibres; the final picture says they still have more development ahead.
